review: Viewed all full-size originals, enlarged hand/boot/toe crops, three casuals together and against recent ledger contact images and Manaphy.
face_comparison: Long narrow face, close-set downturned eyes, straight brows and thin lips, with asymmetrical side-shaved hair. Distinct from Manaphy heart face and large rounded eyes, Phione short curls and recent broader faces.
diversity: Morning ferry in denim overall shorts, active lantern-lit veil dance in two-piece costume, side-seated moonlit velvet suite in silk slip. Activity, silhouette, light and composition differ from each other and from the recent green, red and white-haired casuals.
